projects.name: Customer Analytics Dashboard
projects.description:
A customer analytics dashboard that ingests customer CSV files, analyzes application logs, and presents insights through interactive visualization components. Scope includes: (1) CSV data processing pipeline for customer records, (2) application log analysis for usage/error/performance signals, (3) a modeled analytics data store, (4) reusable visualization components, (5) dashboard integration and UX, (6) testing and performance validation, and (7) deployment and documentation. Goal is a production-ready analytics dashboard delivered through clearly scoped, executable milestones and tasks.

Tags: analytics, dashboard, data-processing, log-analysis, visualization, new-project

tasks.name: M1 — Requirements & Architecture Foundation
tasks.details: Establish scope, stakeholders, success metrics, source-system inventory (customer CSV exports and application log sources), and the technical architecture for the analytics dashboard. Deliverables: agreed KPI definitions, data source inventory, architecture diagram, and a prioritized backlog. Exit criteria: architecture and KPI definitions signed off; all source systems and data owners identified.

tasks.name: M2 — Customer CSV Data Processing Pipeline
tasks.details: Build the ingestion and processing pipeline for customer CSV files: schema discovery, validation, cleaning, normalization, deduplication, and loading into the analytics store with observable error handling. Exit criteria: CSVs from all known sources load end-to-end with a documented data quality report and repeatable job runs.

tasks.name: M3 — Application Log Analysis Pipeline
tasks.details: Build parsing and aggregation for application logs to derive usage, error-rate, latency, and engagement signals. Covers log format contracts, parsing/normalization, sessionization, metric aggregation, and anomaly flagging. Exit criteria: logs from all app services parse reliably and produce the agreed daily/hourly metrics.

tasks.name: M4 — Analytics Data Model & Storage Layer
tasks.details: Design and implement the analytics data store: dimensional/fact model for customers, events, sessions, and metrics; table/index creation; refresh and retention strategy; and a semantic/metrics layer the dashboard queries. Exit criteria: dashboard-ready tables populated, documented metric definitions, and query performance within target.

tasks.name: M5 — Visualization Component Library
tasks.details: Implement reusable chart and UI components (KPI cards, trend lines, cohort/segmentation charts, error/latency views, filters) with loading, empty, and error states, accessibility support, and a consistent design-token theme. Exit criteria: component library documented in Storybook (or equivalent) and approved by design.

tasks.name: M6 — Dashboard Integration & UX Assembly
tasks.details: Assemble the dashboard pages: layout and navigation, KPI overview, customer analytics views, log/health views, global filters and date range, shared state, and drill-down interactions. Wire components to the metrics layer with caching and loading behavior. Exit criteria: all agreed views usable end-to-end with real and seeded data.

tasks.name: M7 — Testing, Performance & Launch Readiness
tasks.details: Validate quality and operational readiness: automated tests for pipelines and components, data accuracy reconciliation, query/load performance testing, security and access review, deployment pipeline, monitoring/alerting, runbooks, and user documentation. Exit criteria: release checklist complete and sign-off from data, engineering, and product owners.

tasks.name: Run stakeholder interviews and define dashboard KPIs
tasks.details: Interview product, support, customer success, and engineering stakeholders. Capture the decisions the dashboard must support, then write 8–12 KPI definitions with formula, grain, owner, and target. Output: KPI definition doc approved by stakeholders.

tasks.name: Inventory customer CSV sources and document schemas
tasks.details: List every customer CSV source, delivery mechanism, refresh cadence, and owner. For each file capture column names, types, nullability, encoding, delimiters, volume, and known quality issues. Output: CSV source catalog with sample files.

tasks.name: Inventory application log sources and formats
tasks.details: Identify all application services writing logs, their format (JSON/plaintext), fields, retention, sample volume, and access method. Document event types needed for usage, error, and latency metrics. Output: log source catalog with representative samples.

tasks.name: Define analytics architecture and technology stack
tasks.details: Produce an architecture diagram and decision record covering ingestion, storage/warehouse, transformation, metrics/API layer, frontend, scheduling, and hosting. Evaluate one build-vs-buy option for the warehouse and charting library. Output: approved architecture decision record.

tasks.name: Create prioritized delivery backlog and release plan
tasks.details: Turn KPI definitions and source inventory into a prioritized backlog aligned to the seven milestones. Define MVP scope vs. later phases, estimate rough effort, and confirm the milestone dependency chain with the team. Output: backlog and release plan in the project tracker.

tasks.name: Build CSV ingestion job with file discovery and scheduling
tasks.details: Implement a job that discovers new/changed customer CSV files from the documented locations (local drop, SFTP, or object storage), tracks processed files, handles retries, and can run on a schedule. Output: ingestion job with run log and idempotent file tracking.

tasks.name: Implement CSV schema validation and bad-row quarantine
tasks.details: Validate each CSV against its documented schema: required columns, data types, accepted value ranges, and encoding. Route failures to a quarantine location with row-level error reasons, and emit a per-run validation summary. Output: validation module and quarantine report.

tasks.name: Implement cleaning and normalization transforms
tasks.details: Normalize names, emails, phone numbers, country codes, dates/timestamps, and currency fields; standardize nulls and categorical values. Handle encoding issues and whitespace. Output: transformation module with unit-tested rules applied to all customer CSV sources.

tasks.name: Implement deduplication and customer identity matching
tasks.details: Define the customer identity key (normalized email plus source ID fallback), detect exact and fuzzy duplicates, and merge records with survivorship rules. Preserve a mapping of source records to canonical customer IDs. Output: dedupe module and duplicate report.

tasks.name: Load cleaned CSVs to staging with data quality report
tasks.details: Write validated, normalized, deduplicated records to the staging layer in the analytics store using an idempotent upsert. Produce a per-run data quality report covering row counts, rejected rows, duplicate rate, null rates, and schema drift. Output: staging load job and data quality report.

tasks.name: Define log ingestion contract and sampling plan
tasks.details: Document required log fields (timestamp, service, level, user/customer ID, request ID, route, status, duration), timezone rules, and format guarantees per service. Collect representative samples and define how to handle malformed or partial lines. Output: log contract doc and sample corpus.

tasks.name: Implement log parser and normalizer
tasks.details: Parse JSON and plaintext log lines into a unified event schema: normalize timestamps to UTC, severity levels, service names, status codes, and durations. Quarantine unparseable lines with reasons. Output: parser module with coverage metrics per source.

tasks.name: Implement sessionization of user activity events
tasks.details: Group parsed events into sessions per customer/user using inactivity timeout and request-ID continuity rules. Derive session start/end, duration, event count, entry/exit routes, and error presence. Output: sessionization module and session table feed.

tasks.name: Build hourly and daily metric aggregations
tasks.details: Compute agreed metrics from parsed/sessionized logs: active users, requests, error rate, 4xx/5xx counts, p50/p95/p99 latency, and top routes/services. Write to aggregate tables partitioned by hour and day. Output: aggregation jobs and metric validation against raw counts.

tasks.name: Implement anomaly threshold flagging for errors and latency
tasks.details: Add configurable thresholds and simple baseline comparisons (rolling mean/stddev) to flag error-rate and latency spikes by service and route. Persist flags with severity and context for dashboard surfacing. Output: anomaly flagging job and rule configuration.

tasks.name: Design dimensional model for customers, events, and sessions
tasks.details: Design fact and dimension tables (dim_customer, dim_date, dim_service, fact_event, fact_session, fact_daily_metrics) with grain, keys, and relationships. Document metric definitions and map each dashboard KPI to a table and calculation. Output: approved data model ERD.

tasks.name: Create tables, partitions, indexes, and retention policy
tasks.details: Implement the schema via migration scripts: create tables, partitioning by date, indexes/clustering keys for dashboard access patterns, and a documented retention and archival policy. Include rollback scripts. Output: migrations applied to dev and staging.

tasks.name: Build orchestrated refresh jobs with idempotency and backfill
tasks.details: Chain CSV and log pipelines into a scheduled, dependency-aware refresh (staging → modeled → aggregates). Ensure reruns are idempotent, support date-range backfills, and emit run status and failure alerts. Output: orchestration definitions and runbook notes.

tasks.name: Define semantic metrics layer and query endpoints
tasks.details: Build a thin metrics/semantic layer that exposes named, parameterized queries (date range, segment, service) for each KPI so the frontend never writes raw SQL. Include pagination, caching hooks, and consistent response shapes. Output: documented metrics API contract.

tasks.name: Benchmark and tune dashboard queries
tasks.details: Create a representative dataset, measure each metrics endpoint against target latency (e.g., p95 < 1.5s), then tune indexes, partitions, and pre-aggregation as needed. Record before/after benchmarks. Output: performance baseline and tuning changes.

tasks.name: Scaffold component library with theme and design tokens
tasks.details: Set up the frontend component workspace (e.g., Storybook or equivalent), charting dependency, TypeScript types for metrics payloads, color/typography/spacing tokens, and a component folder structure. Output: running component dev environment.

tasks.name: Build KPI card and trend chart components
tasks.details: Implement KPI cards (value, delta, sparkline, target) and time-series trend charts with tooltip, legend, and responsive sizing. Support comparison periods. Output: documented KPI and trend components with stories and sample data.

tasks.name: Build segmentation, cohort, and distribution charts
tasks.details: Implement components for customer segmentation breakdowns (bar/pie/stacked), cohort retention heatmap, and value-distribution histograms. Include sortable legends and consistent formatting. Output: documented components with stories.

tasks.name: Build log health, error, and latency components
tasks.details: Implement error-rate over time, status-code breakdown, latency percentile chart, top-failing routes table, and anomaly badge components tailored to the log metric payloads. Output: documented components with realistic sample data.

tasks.name: Build filter, date-range, and data table components
tasks.details: Implement reusable filter controls (multi-select, search, segment/service selection), a date-range picker with presets, and a sortable/paginated data table with column formatting and empty states. Output: documented components with stories and controlled-state APIs.

tasks.name: Add loading, empty, and error states plus accessibility pass
tasks.details: Standardize skeleton loaders, empty-state messaging, and error/retry panels across all chart components. Run an accessibility pass: keyboard navigation, ARIA labels, color-contrast-safe palettes, and screen-reader summaries for charts. Output: a11y checklist and fixes.

tasks.name: Implement dashboard shell with layout, navigation, and routing
tasks.details: Create the app shell: responsive layout, sidebar/top navigation, route structure for overview, customers, and application health pages, error boundaries, and a consistent page header. Output: navigable dashboard skeleton deployed to a preview environment.

tasks.name: Assemble KPI overview page
tasks.details: Compose the executive overview from KPI cards and trend components: headline customer and usage metrics, period comparison, and top movers. Wire to the metrics layer and validate numbers against the data model. Output: working overview page.

tasks.name: Assemble customer analytics page
tasks.details: Compose the customer analytics view: segment breakdown, growth/retention trends, cohort heatmap, and a searchable customer table. Wire to metrics endpoints and confirm filter semantics with stakeholders. Output: working customer analytics page.

tasks.name: Assemble application health and log analytics page
tasks.details: Compose the log analytics view: error rate and latency trends, status-code breakdown, top failing routes, anomaly alerts, and service filter. Wire to log metric endpoints. Output: working application health page.

tasks.name: Wire global filters, date range, and shared dashboard state
tasks.details: Implement app-level filter state (date range, segment, service) synced to URL query parameters so views are shareable. Ensure all pages and components react consistently and refetch correctly. Output: shared filter state with URL persistence.

tasks.name: Add drill-down interactions and CSV export
tasks.details: Add click-through from charts to filtered detail views (e.g., segment → customer list, service → failing routes) and CSV export for tables with the active filters applied. Include permission checks on exported fields. Output: drill-down and export behavior.

tasks.name: Write unit tests for CSV and log pipelines
tasks.details: Cover parsing, validation, normalization, deduplication, sessionization, and aggregation with unit tests and fixture CSVs/log samples, including malformed input cases. Target meaningful coverage of transformation logic. Output: test suite running in CI.

tasks.name: Add component tests and end-to-end dashboard tests
tasks.details: Write component tests for chart/filter/table states and Playwright (or equivalent) E2E tests for the three main pages: load, filter, drill-down, and export. Include seeded data for deterministic runs. Output: green component and E2E suites in CI.

tasks.name: Reconcile dashboard metrics against source systems
tasks.details: For a sample period, compare dashboard counts and metrics to source-of-truth queries in the CSV sources and raw logs. Investigate and document every variance above an agreed tolerance. Output: signed-off reconciliation report.

tasks.name: Run load and performance tests on dashboard and queries
tasks.details: Load-test the metrics endpoints and dashboard with expected concurrent users and production-scale data volume. Verify p95 page and query latency targets, identify bottlenecks, and re-tune as needed. Output: performance test report and remediation list.

tasks.name: Complete security and PII access review
tasks.details: Classify customer fields by sensitivity, confirm PII is masked or excluded where required, review authentication/authorization on dashboard routes and metrics endpoints, verify export restrictions, and check secrets handling. Output: security review sign-off with fixes closed.

tasks.name: Set up CI/CD, monitoring, and alerting
tasks.details: Create the build/test/deploy pipeline with environment promotion, plus monitoring for pipeline freshness, job failures, endpoint latency, and dashboard error rate. Configure alerts to the on-call channel. Output: production deployment pipeline and alert dashboard.

tasks.name: Write runbooks and user documentation, complete launch sign-off
tasks.details: Document pipeline operations (rerun, backfill, quarantine recovery), dashboard metric definitions and filter behavior, and support escalation. Run a launch readiness review against the release checklist and collect sign-off from data, engineering, and product owners. Output: published docs and signed launch checklist.

tasks.name: Build data-fetching layer with caching and error handling
tasks.details: Implement typed API clients for all metrics endpoints with request de-duplication, caching/stale-while-revalidate, retry with backoff, and consistent error surfaces. Add loading skeletons and partial-failure handling per panel. Output: data layer used by every dashboard page.
